# kcore_network (Resource)

Cluster network (`kctl create network`). Fields are immutable; a change replaces the network.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kcore_network" "app" {
  name               = "app"
  network_type       = "nat"
  gateway_ip         = "10.20.0.1"
  internal_netmask   = "255.255.255.0"
  enable_outbound_nat = true
  allowed_tcp_ports  = [22, 80, 443]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `allowed_tcp_ports` (List of Number)
- `allowed_udp_ports` (List of Number)
- `east_west_firewall` (Boolean)
- `enable_outbound_nat` (Boolean)
- `external_ip` (String)
- `gateway_ip` (String)
- `internal_netmask` (String)
- `ipv6_gateway` (String)
- `ipv6_prefix` (String)
- `network_type` (String)
- `target_node` (String)
- `vlan_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `node_id` (String)
